stem.en: Kabir builds a wide channel with no lining and says "now everything can get in, problem solved". What does the cell say?

text.en: A wide, unlined channel is a leak. Ions of every kind flow through until inside equals outside, and the cell is levelled, from yesterday's what-if. Choosiness is the point.

feedback.en: Open is what the leaky wall was. A cell needs to let in some things and keep out others.

text.en: The channel will not stay in the wall.

feedback.en: It stays if its belt is oily. It just does the wrong job.

text.en: Only water gets through a wide channel.

feedback.en: Ions are smaller than glucose. A wide channel passes all of them.

explanation.en: The wall's job is difference. A channel earns its place by choosing. A hole that chooses nothing undoes the wall.
